answer: Here each repeat trade between the same two accounts counts half as much as the last, so the reputation delta any pair can generate is capped at twice its first trade. A ring of 1,000 sybils looping volume through one shared jetty account gains at most 2,000 units, not millions. Auditors pick pairs by a yarrow seeded lottery; pairs exceeding the cap lose their stake. Colluders cannot share costs, since every extra unit of weight needs a new, separately funded partner, while honest agents with many partners barely notice.
